Fieldnote · Independent studio

Small pages, built to be read.

A reference page for teams that want a clear offer, a calm reading rhythm and a build that survives a phone, a slow connection and a careful review.

See the working method Read the standard

What this page proves

  • 16px body copy floor
  • 62ch maximum measure
  • 44px minimum target
  • 4.5:1 minimum contrast

A short method, applied with care.

Three decisions keep the page honest: one offer, one visual system and one measured reading column.

Name the offer

A visitor should know what is sold and what happens next before the first scroll.

Build the system

Tokens, container, grid, type scale, buttons and focus ring come before sections.

Check the browser

Real Chrome at seven widths decides whether the page is finished. Compilation does not.

The gate is the definition of done.

A page passes when the browser proves it: readable type, real contrast, clean stacking, visible focus and copy that names the outcome.

  • Every section has one idea and a deliberate screen budget.
  • Every action uses a verb and an object.
  • Every image carries its source and a usable description.
  • Every animation respects the visitor's reduced-motion setting.

Fieldnote is a demonstration fixture. Write to studio@fieldnote.example.
